description: Plan solar modules on a house's roof from the Bavarian 3D building model, the aerial photo and the laser scan, exactly as Sky Solar's solar roof check page does: modules, kWp, kWh a year with measured weather, shade loss and self-use with and without a battery, each roof face with tilt and direction, the obstacles found, money a year at public rates (own use and feed-in) for a choice of battery sizes (none, or 4 to 20 kWh; any whole kWh in between on request), the municipal subsidy and, with an offer price, the payback, kWh month by month and per face, the worst shade casters, questions about unsure spots for the person and what else to ask them, notes on likely model errors, and a solar roof check link that opens this plan in 3D for the person to check, change and send an enquiry from. On a new plan (house) where the aerial photo speaks against the roof's outline, the AI outline check runs by itself, as on the page: "applied" says what it changed. A link is read as it is; "notes" says when the outline may still be wrong. Give house (from find_house) for a new plan, or link to read and explain a plan the person already has. Pass the person's answers to the questions with answers. Works outside Sky Solar's service area too and says so. An example, not a quote; no prices.

answers.description: The person's answers to the last answer's "questions".

id.description: The id of a question from the last answer.

obstacle.description: true: there is an obstacle there; false: there is none.

battery_kwh.description: Battery size, kWh: 0 for none, or a whole number from 4 to 20 (default 8).

battery_type.description: The battery's type, both DC-coupled hybrid systems: "nv5" (low voltage, the default) charges and discharges at most 5 kW whatever its size; "hv1c" (high voltage) at most 1C, as many kW as it has kWh (10 kWh: 10 kW, 4 kWh: only 4 kW). Only with a battery. It matters at peaks: an e-car charging at more than 5 kW; a household on its own comes out nearly the same with both, with a heat pump too.

consumption_kwh.description: The household's electricity use a year, kWh, without car or heat pump (default 4,500).

ev.description: An electric car is (or will be) charged at home: by default 15,000 km a year, about 2,955 kWh, charged in the evening (edit_roof device sets km, when and how fast).

geometry.description: true: add a complete geometry snapshot to the answer (the default stays short): for every face and dormer roof its outline, size, usable box and the eave and slope axes (with compass bearings), every module with its face, position in the face's own metres and orientation, the module fields (rows × columns), and the obstacles with their outlines and clearances. Everything in the same metres the edits take.

heat_pump.description: A heat pump heats the house: by default about 4,500 kWh a year, mostly in winter (edit_roof device sets the person's own figure).

house.description: The house id from find_house ("musterhaus" is the example house).

link.description: A solar roof check link (https://pv.skysolar.de/dachcheck/#d=…), as plan_roof, edit_roof or the solar roof check page gave it.

offer_eur.description: The total price on an offer the person already has, euros before any subsidy (0 clears it): the solar roof check link then shows the payback. Never a price of Sky Solar's.

name: plan_roof
title: Plan a roof (solar roof check)
